verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own H200 page publishes capacity, memory type and bandwidth (141 GB of HBM3e at 4.8 TB/s), framed against the H100. The 6144-bit bus width appears only in a community comment, not in NVIDIA's published specs. The same page also mixes SXM and NVL variants, so it doesn't clearly tie the figures to the SXM part. missing for 10: first-party bus-width specification, an SXM-specific spec sheet that separates SXM from NVL figures, independent corroboration of the bandwidth numbers.
